population_roles.TRAIN_GEOMETRY: all fitting, selection and LOSO outcomes
population_roles.OUTER_DEVELOPMENT: evaluation after all choices are frozen

prior_outer_exposure_caveat: The same OUTER_DEVELOPMENT population has been inspected in earlier mechanism experiments; this branch locks its protocol before any new OUTER extraction but is not an untouched prospective cohort.
representation: exact 64-D native EEGNet final-affine input; per-batch native logit identity rtol=1e-5 atol=1e-6
decision_coordinate: one StandardScaler fitted on all legal TRAIN subject S1 embeddings for final OUTER evaluation; each strict TRAIN LOSO episode refits one shared StandardScaler after removing its held subject
best_global_choice: TRAIN subject-equal S2 BA from native versus GLOBAL_REFIT trained excluding each held TRAIN subject; tie lower NLL, then native
oracle: subject S1 labelled L2 logistic C=1; diagnostic target only, evaluated on that subject S2
context_primary: all unlabeled subject S1 rows in frozen cache order
pc_augmentation: CTX_COMBINED_PLUS_PC secondary only; source-only Protected basis from prior PEEH, half-crossfit for TRAIN LOSO and all TRAIN for OUTER; no P/C classifier manipulation
nested_train_selection: for each held TRAIN subject, choose descriptor/rank/ridge using inner subject-LOSO among other TRAIN subjects, scored on inner subject S2 with subject-equal BA; ties NLL, descriptor order, lower rank, higher regularization; refit all transforms and correction basis without inner held subject
final_train_selection: same inner subject-LOSO over all TRAIN subjects selects deployable descriptor/rank/ridge before OUTER
budget_sensitivity: for each B, refit TRAIN-only descriptor normalization/mapper with the final full-context rank/ridge/descriptor family; never tune B on OUTER
shuffle_control: permute TRAIN subject context rows before mapper fit; preserve TRAIN subject correction targets and all selected hyperparameters; evaluate OUTER subject means for each deterministic draw
function_anchor: deterministic class-balanced first four TRAIN S1 trials per subject/class only; no OUTER anchors
bootstrap_unit: unique biological subject after averaging repeated fold appearances
